## Definition
A network topology configuration specifically optimized to enable cognitive tasks by leveraging both strong and weak connections in a balanced manner. Provides a blueprint for iNEST neuromorphic systems to achieve cognitive-like processing through topology-aware design, not just neuron-level dynamics.
